title: Sponsorship Manager
description:
Sponsorship Manager

Location: London, White City - Hybrid

Closing Date: 27/10/2026

The role

We are recruiting for a Sponsorship Manager within the BEStudio Sponsorship team.

This is a varied, client-facing role that sits at the heart of ITV Commercial, working closely with agencies, clients and a wide range of internal teams to develop and deliver best-in-class sponsorship campaigns.

As Sponsorship Manager, you will lead the end-to-end project management of the sponsorship deals assigned to you, overseeing all elements of campaign delivery across Broadcast, Streaming, Digital, Social, Licensing, Experiential and Product Placement. Acting as the central point of coordination, you will ensure campaigns are delivered seamlessly by bringing together internal stakeholders and agency partners.

You will build strong relationships with clients and agencies, ensuring campaigns are delivered to the highest standard while identifying opportunities to evolve the commercial proposition and deepen brand integration across programmes and sponsorship packages.

You will also act as the commercial ‘Brand Champion’ for the sponsorship opportunities assigned to you, helping to shape how they are positioned in the market and ensuring they are delivered with collaboration, energy and enthusiasm.

Please note that this is primarily a project management and campaign delivery role. While you will work closely with the Commercial Sales team and support sponsorship pitches as required, your core responsibility will be the build, activation, and successful delivery of sponsorship campaigns.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of assigned sponsorship campaigns, ensuring all contractual, operational and administrative requirements are met
  • Act as the Brand Champion for assigned sponsorship properties, developing deep expertise in each opportunity, shaping how it is positioned to market, and ensuring it is represented consistently and compellingly across sales materials, client conversations and campaign delivery
  • Develop and deliver high-quality sales materials, including presentations and supporting content, to effectively showcase sponsorship opportunities
  • Provide best-in-class project management across the full sponsorship lifecycle, delivering campaigns across 360 touchpoints in collaboration with internal and external partners
  • Champion sponsorship internally and externally, ensuring the full breadth of ITV’s platforms and audience touchpoints are considered in sponsorship conversations.
  • Support teams in pitching sponsorship opportunities to clients and agencies, sharing expert knowledge of assigned properties and presenting campaign results
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key ITV stakeholders including Production, Commissioning, Legal, Finance, Press, Traffic, Marketing and Compliance to ensure seamless campaign delivery.
  • Ensure clear communication across internal teams, keeping teams informed of programme developments, scheduling changes or other updates that may impact sponsorship opportunities.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to maximise the commercial potential of sponsorship properties, working with relevant stakeholders to develop innovative and market-leading solutions.
  • Work closely with the Deputy Sponsorship Controller and Sponsorship Controller to evolve ITV’s sponsorship offering, exploring new formats, market trends and creative opportunities

Skills you'll need (minimum criteria)

  • Proven experience delivering sponsorship campaigns from start to finish, including high-value and complex deal parameters.
  • Strong client servicing experience, with a proven ability to build and manage senior relationships with media agencies and direct clients
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-value environment while maintaining exceptional attention to detail
  • Excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage complex campaign delivery and exceed customer expectations
  • Proven ability to craft strategic solutions and confidently pitch ideas to clients and agencies, demonstrating creative thinking to navigate complex commercial challenges
  • Excellent presentation, negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to influence and inspire stakeholders at all levels
  • Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional teams, building meaningful relationships across the wider teams to maximise commercial opportunities.
  • Demonstrated creativity and strategic thinking, with the ability to work through complexities and inspire stakeholder confidence.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to operate autonomously, exercise sound judgement and remain calm under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for ITV, its content and the role brands play within sponsorship and commercial partnerships.

Other things we're looking for (key criteria)

  • Proactive, motivated and results-driven, with a positive and collaborative approach to teamwork.
  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong focus on accuracy and high standards of work.
  • Committed, hardworking and conscientious, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Personable and collaborative, able to build strong relationships with clients, agencies and a wide range of internal teams.
  • A natural problem solver, able to identify solutions that deliver value for both ITV and sponsor brands.
  • Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and credibility at all levels.

title: National Standardised Assessments Training Officer
description:
This is an Expression of Interest (EOI) opportunity, available on a lateral move basis only. Applications are open to Core Scottish Government employees only.

Working Arrangement – Staff in roles compatible with hybrid working should aim to spend 40% of their contracted working time working in person at their contractual workplace. More information can be found within Hybrid Working Policy .

National Standardised Assessments Training Officer (0.8 FTE)

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the heart of the Education Directorate, in a varied and interesting post.

The Equality and Data for Improvement Unit is part of the Workforce, Quality and Wellbeing Division. This post sits in the team responsible for delivering the National Standardised Assessments for Scotland (NSA), which support teachers’ professional judgements on learners’ progress in literacy and numeracy.

The NSA Training Officer will work closely with the NSA Content Manager (C1) and other team members to ensure that training provision meets the needs of schools, local authorities, and internal colleagues. The role will involve designing and delivering training sessions (both online and in-person), creating user guidance and support materials, and evaluating training effectiveness.

Vacancies close at 11:59pm on the date displayed in the table, unless otherwise stated on the job advert.

title: Protection Associate – Case Management
description:
Under the overall supervision of the ​​Head of Programmes ​​and direct supervision of the ​​Protection Coordinator, and where needed with the technical support from GAVR Protection Coordinator or Senior Return Specialist , the Protection Associate – Case Management will be based in Kigali, Rwanda and will be responsible and accountable for:

  1. Facilitate individual protection screening of vulnerable migrants, using IOM’s standard screening tools to identify migrant’s risks and vulnerabilities for appropriate case management support.

  2. Document and identify migrants’ basic and specific needs, coordinate with multi-disciplinary team, prepare individual case management plans and record referral actions with full participation of migrants using culturally, age- and linguistically-appropriate communication method.

  3. Provide case management support by providing individualised assistance, processing referrals for specialised services (i.e. consular, health, psychosocial, voluntary return, family tracing, risk assessment, and others), monitoring and documenting progress and maintaining case records.

  4. Support the coordination of case management activities with other IOM Country Offices (COs), Regional Thematic Specialist (RTS), Migrant Health Unit (MHU), and other relevant IOM units by assessing protection risk, sharing of individual case files, when needed, providing remote counselling, facilitating consular assistance including coordination with relevant authorities, provision of post arrival support, AVR movements, and supporting migrants in accessing relevant documentation.

  5. Apply IOM’s established protection principles and case management procedures when providing assistance, maintaining confidentiality and data protection, supporting equitable and inclusive access to services, promoting informed participation, and documenting feedback through coordinated case management activities.

  6. Maintain accurate and timely data collection and case notes/records in IOM’s case management systems (including MiMOSA and program-specific tools), in accordance with data protection and confidentiality standards.

  7. Compile case information and assist the MHPSS Response Officer in preparing reports, summaries, case work outcomes, lessons learned and monitoring of protection-related project indicators as required by the programme.

  8. Undertake duty travel, as required, to support the delivery of assigned case management activities.

  9. Attend meetings, when required, with related units or stakeholders .

  10. Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Social Sciences, International Relations/Affairs, Research, Law or a related field from an accredited academic institution with three years of relevant professional experience; or,

  • High School Diploma with five years of relevant professional experience.

  • Experience in protection case management (including for survivors of gender based violence and human trafficking, children at risk) in humanitarian or migration contexts;

  • Experience working with vulnerable persons, ideally including returnees or deported migrants, who have complex needs;

  • Experience with referrals and coordination with local protection actors, NGOs, or government services;

  • Experience working in programs that include a movement operations component is an advantage; and,

  • Experience with IOM or other UN agencies, particularly working on assisted voluntary return and reintegration programs, is preferred.

title: Lead Full Stack Engineer (all genders)
description:
About GeneralMind

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

About the role

We are looking for a Lead Full Stack Engineer to own and evolve the core architecture of the company across both the frontend and backend, and to set the technical bar for how the rest of the engineering team builds full-stack features.

You will work directly with the founders on systems that orchestrate real operational workflows across emails, documents, humans, databases, and ERP systems. A crucial part of this role is bridging our AI infrastructure with user experience - you will build the next-generation interfaces where human operators collaborate with our Systems of Action, and make the architectural calls that other engineers will build on top of. The work sits at the intersection of full-stack engineering, workflow orchestration, UI/UX architecture, and AI infrastructure.

This is not a feature-factory role. We want someone who can hold large parts of the system in their head, make strong architectural decisions across the stack, and raise the quality bar for the team.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and evolve production-grade full-stack applications using Python (FastAPI) and React (Next.js).
  • Architect and develop next-generation interfaces for our Systems of Action, enabling seamless human-in-the-loop interactions and complex data visualization.
  • Build durable backend workflow systems using tools like Temporal to support asynchronous AI agent execution.
  • Improve reliability, observability, and operational tooling across both client and server applications.
  • Integrate with enterprise systems such as ERP platforms (SAP, Dynamics, etc.) and external APIs, surfacing that data intuitively on the frontend.
  • Scale multi-tenant systems, database architectures (PostgreSQL), and platform abstractions.
  • Work closely with product and forward-deployed engineering teams to translate real customer problems into cohesive end-to-end features.

What we are looking for

  • Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals and production experience owning end-to-end feature delivery.
  • Deep experience with React and modern frontend ecosystems, coupled with a strong eye for user experience and interface design.
  • Deep experience with Python and distributed / backend systems.
  • A strong ownership mentality and systems thinking - you care just as much about UI state management as you do about backend database query optimization.
  • Ability to design reliable, observable, maintainable systems.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments.
  • Clear communication and sound engineering judgment.
  • Excitement about AI-native software development and agentic systems.

Join GeneralMind as a Lead Full Stack Engineer! Drive innovation in AI, transform enterprise workflows, and grow with us. Be part of a team shaping the future of business automation!

title: Senior Officer - Country Affairs
description:
ARK Country Affairs Senior Officer

Position Description

Kibali Gold Mine is seeking to recruit a suitably qualified and experienced Country Affairs Senior Officer to support the ARK Project mine expansion.

Based in the country office in Kinshasa and reporting to the Country Manager, the Country Affairs Officer will provide dedicated coordination between the ARK site team and the relevant government administrations. The role will support the preparation and filing of expansion dossiers, follow up applications and authorisations, track approvals, and coordinate technical responses to administrative requests.

The incumbent will assist the Country Manager with ARK-related government engagements and work closely with project leadership and the specialist teams responsible for various admin requests. The role will operate within the existing country-office structure, with technical validation and specialist responsibilities remaining with the relevant functions.

The incumbent will be expected to uphold Barrick’s DNA and contribute in a safe, ethical and cost-effective manner, in accordance with company standards, policies and procedures.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Serve as the day-to-day coordination point between the ARK site team, the country office, and the relevant government administrations in Kinshasa, ensuring that information, requests, and follow-up actions are handled promptly.

  • Coordinate the preparation and compilation of expansion dossiers, applications and supporting documents, obtaining the required technical, legal, commercial and administrative inputs from the responsible teams.

  • Check dossier completeness, consistency and submission readiness, ensuring that required internal reviews, signatures and supporting documents are obtained before filing.

  • Prepare draft correspondence, covering letters, administrative notes and briefing materials for review and approval by the Country Manager and Project Manager and the relevant internal specialists.

  • Submit approved dossiers and applications to the relevant administrations, obtain filing receipts or acknowledgements, and maintain a clear record of submission dates, reference numbers and responsible contacts.

  • Support the Country Manager on ARK-related matters involving ARSP and other relevant government bodies, coordinating documentation, administrative follow-up and responses with Procurement, Legal and the project team.

  • Coordinate administrative follow-up of authorisations and approvals relating to hydroelectric development and associated infrastructure, in liaison with Engineering, Environment, Legal and other responsible functions.

  • Liaise with the teams responsible for import filings, customs and logistics to coordinate ARK documentation, track outstanding administrative requirements and flag issues affecting project deliveries.

  • Liaise with HR and the teams responsible for visas, work permits and immigration documentation to coordinate project requirements and follow up outstanding applications affecting mobilisation.

  • Maintain an up-to-date register of project submissions, permits and approvals, recording internal owners, status, outstanding requirements, target dates, next actions and relevant validity or renewal dates.

  • Receive and route requests for clarification or additional information from government bodies, coordinate timely technical responses from site and specialist teams, and arrange submission through the approved channels.

  • Assist the Country Manager in preparing for and attending ARK-related government meetings, including briefing packs, dossier summaries and outstanding issues; record agreed actions and coordinate follow-up.

  • Maintain professional working relationships with designated administrative contacts and facilitate clear, consistent communication in accordance with the Country Manager’s direction and company protocols.

  • Provide regular progress updates to the Country Manager and ARK project leadership, highlighting approval dependencies, overdue actions and administrative constraints that may affect project milestones.

  • Maintain accurate and secure records of correspondence, submissions, receipts, meeting notes and approvals, working with project document control to ensure traceability, version control and confidentiality.

  • Escalate sensitive issues and unresolved delays promptly and conduct all activities with integrity and in accordance with company compliance requirements, delegated authority and applicable procedures.

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Public Administration, Law, Business Administration, Economics, Project Management or a related discipline.

  • Additional training in regulatory affairs, government relations, mining administration, project coordination or document management will be advantageous.

Experience and Skills Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience in government liaison, regulatory affairs, administrative coordination, permitting or a similar role, preferably within mining, energy, infrastructure or major projects in the DRC.

  • Demonstrated experience preparing, filing and following up administrative dossiers with government departments and public bodies in Kinshasa.

  • Practical familiarity with government-related administrative matters and the coordination of project authorisations in various areas (ARSP, local content, etc.) will be advantageous.

  • Experience coordinating with technical, legal, procurement, import, logistics, infrastructure development and immigration related requests or approvals will be an advantage.

  • Excellent written and spoken French, including the ability to draft clear, formal correspondence and administrative submissions and a working proficiency in English.

  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple dossiers, deadlines and follow-up actions simultaneously.

  • Ability to understand technical and administrative requests, identify the appropriate internal specialists and coordinate complete, accurate responses.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, sound judgement, diplomacy, discretion and a high standard of integrity when dealing with government bodies and confidential information.

  • Ability to work independently within agreed priorities and authority, collaborate across a multicultural team, and travel to site or other administrative locations as required.

Key Competencies

  • High level of confidentiality, integrity, impartiality and professionalism.

  • Strong problem-solving capability.

  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced project environment with strong attention to detail and urgency.

  • Strong safety mindset and commitment to Barrick’s Journey to Zero culture.

  • Ability to build trust, drive accountability and promote a respectful, inclusive and high-performance project environment.

What We Can Offer You

  • A comprehensive compensation package in line with company policy.

  • The ability to make a difference and lasting impact.

  • Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team.

  • Opportunities to grow and learn with industry colleagues.

  • Access to a variety of career opportunities across the organization.

We are committed to a safe work environment ensuring every person going home safe and healthy every day and leaving a sustainable legacy in our host communities.

Thank you for your application, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Fitness and Restorative Wellness Trainer
description:
We are seeking a passionate and creative Fitness & Restorative Wellness Trainer to design and lead an engaging, whole-person wellness program for residents in our senior living community. This is more than personal training — it's an opportunity to build a dynamic, rehabilitation-minded program that improves strength, balance, mobility, and quality of life through innovative and meaningful movement experiences. We welcome candidates from personal training, restorative care, occupational therapy, and physical therapy backgrounds who are excited to bring fresh ideas to senior wellness.


Key Responsibilities


Conduct individualized fitness and functional movement assessments to establish baselines in strength, balance, flexibility, and daily living performance. Design and deliver creative, restorative programming — including strength training, balance and fall-prevention circuits, chair yoga, therapeutic movement, and sensory or cognitive-motor activities. Lead both one-on-one sessions and energetic group classes that keep residents motivated and engaged. Collaborate closely with nursing staff, physical therapists, occupational therapists, and restorative aides to create cohesive, care-aligned wellness plans. Develop programming that bridges the gap between skilled therapy discharge and long-term functional independence. Educate residents, families, and care staff on the role of consistent movement in healthy aging, fall prevention, and chronic condition management. Track and document resident progress, participation, and functional improvements. Contribute new ideas and help shape the evolution of our wellness program — your creativity is genuinely welcomed here.

title: Solution Lead
description:
Position Overview

As a member of the Account Services Team, the Solution Lead is responsible for providing architectural leadership in the solution design and implementation of Intelex software. The Solution Lead plays a key role in providing technical leadership in the review and approval of services estimates and the delivery of solution designs for Global Services engagements in order to ensure the solution being proposed to a client is the right one, has identified and mitigated risk, and has minimized the non-billable service time.

Responsibilities and Deliverables

Implementation Support

  • Facilitates project and client transition from Sales to Global Services for new accounts or engagements.
  • Translates client requirements into an Intelex solution design, including workflow and configuration architecture, that will meet client’s overall business objectives while maintain a consideration for cost and timeline targets.
  • Conducts careful and timely reviews of all Services estimates and implementation plans with in order to ensure accuracy and to reduce non-billable service time.
  • Attends Implementation Design Workshops in order to oversee analysis and documentation of business and interface requirements.
  • Ensures architectural consistency and coherence between technical and business processes through systems analysis and design, system modelling, performance modelling, integration planning and technology and component selection.
  • Leads the creation/maintenance of configuration guidelines and best practices in order to ensure efficient, reusable configuration detail is produced by the team and measured through regular reviews.
  • Conducts technical risk assessments through experience, analysis, prototyping and research
  • Provides guidance, training, and mentorship to junior level consultants.
  • Work closely with a Project Manager in order to assess and manage risk, maintain proper resource level on the project team and identify and escalate issues.

Operations

  • Work with other Solution Architects in Global Services to ensure knowledge sharing across project teams and technical resources and ensure consistent problem solving approaches and solutions are developed.
  • Participate in the development and contribute to the continuous progress of Intelex methodology, knowledge based team rooms and other key documentations artifacts.
  • Assist the Product Management organization with execution of product management processes and product development.
  • Provides ongoing feedback on the process improvement of the review, preparation and confirmation of service estimates.
  • Collaborates with leadership to address new project opportunities.
  • Share in the development and contribute to the continuous progress of Intelex methodology, knowledge-based team rooms and other key documentation.
  • Travel to client locations within Canada, the United States and occasional international travel required. Expected travel is 10%-40%.

Organizational Alignment

  • Reports to the Manager, Solutions Delivery

Qualifications

Skills & Work Traits

Required

  • Strong interpersonal skills with an ability to communicate at a high level with various internal and external parties such as clients, vendors, employees and executives.
  • Strong written and verbal skills; including the ability to present technical issues to a non-technical audience.
  • Strong understanding of the software implementation project lifecycle.
  • Results driven with a proven ability to project a positive sales attitude.
  • Ability to understand business needs in order to align the business need into system capabilities.
  • A great teammate, constantly considering ways to improve performance and support others to ensure the team’s overall success
  • An innovator with an inquisitive mind, actively seeking new ways of working through experimentation to solve problems.

Preferred:

  • Understanding of Environmental, Health, Safety or Quality considered an asset.

Technical Competencies

  • Strong understanding of application architecture and design principles.
  • Solid understanding of web-based application architectures.
  • Knowledge of object-oriented design principles.
  • Software and integration configuration experience.

Preferred

  • Ability to design software systems at an abstract/conceptual level as well as at a detailed-level.

Experience

Required:

  • Experience implementing enterprise-wide, multi-site software solutions.
  • Demonstrated history of developing novel configuration approaches that are scalable and repeatable.
  • Experience in coaching team members to further their technical understanding and provide guidance on standard methodology
  • Excellent presentation skills, with experience delivering business and project solution topics to audience of different roles including customers from technical experts to director level

Preferred:

  • Minimum 8 years of software industry experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Services or Software sales, Solution Architect, or Consulting role.
  • Experience in estimating and presenting services proposals.
  • Experience in participating in sales calls as a technical expert.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree or College Diploma in Computer Science/Information Systems, or equivalent Experience

title: Collections Assistant
description:
Title: Collections Assistant
Department: Culture and Heritage
Community: Gatineau, QC
Requisition Number: 1006
Type of Employment: Term ending March 31, 2027

Salary range: $103,476 to $117,452 per year, 37.5 hours/week
Housing: Subsidized Staff Housing is not Available
Union Status: Nunavut Employees Union
Closing date: November 13, 2026 @ 11:59 p.m. eastern time

This employment opportunity is open to all applicants. Applicants must be currently eligible to work in Canada.

An eligibility list may be created to fill future vacancies.

As this is a term position until March 31, 2027, current indeterminate Government of Nunavut employees may be offered a competitive transfer assignment for the duration of the term if they are deemed to be the successful candidate, however this is subject to managerial approval.

Reporting to the Manager, Heritage Collections, the Collections Assistant is responsible for processing and facilitating access to the Government of Nunavut’s (GN) Heritage Collections at the Canadian Museum of Nature’s Collections and Research Facility in Gatineau QC. The position ensures that written and photographic documentation activities are carried out according to professional museum standards. This includes cataloguing, photo documentation, collection inventories, catalogue searches, retrievals and assisting visitors and researchers to access the collections. The position will also provide information, services, and advice on the GN Collections to external stakeholders including the public, researchers, museums, donors, lenders, community heritage organizations and various levels of government.

The Collections Assistant s main responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Processing collections by cataloging, researching and describing collection material;

  • Contributing to maintaining accurate written and electronic information about the holdings, including the Collections catalogue/database by adding and updating information;

  • Assisting with selections through catalogue/database searches;

  • Confirming accuracy of collection documentation, such as availability, measurements and description;

  • Assisting with the preparation of collection material for exhibition or loan, including packing and unpacking;

  • Providing collection documentation for researchers and other visitors in accordance with copyright legislation and Heritage Collections Program policies;

  • Responding to internal and external requests for collection information.

The knowledge, skills, and abilities required for this job are usually obtained through a recognized:

  • Post-secondary certificate or diploma in Museum Studies or Collections Management;
  • three (3) years’ experience working with multi-disciplinary collections in a Museum, Archives or Cultural Heritage Centre;
  • One (1) year working with Inuit collections;
  • Master’s degree in museum studies is considered as an asset.

This is a Position of Trust and a satisfactory Criminal Record Check is required.

The Official Languages of Nunavut are Inuktitut, English and French. Applicants may submit their resume in any of the official languages of Nunavut. Fluency in more than one of Nunavut’s official languages would be considered an asset. Knowledge of Inuit communities, culture, land, Inuit Qaujimajatuqangit, Inuktitut and experience working in a northern cross-cultural environment are also considered assets.

Acceptable combinations of education and experience may be considered for this position. We encourage you to apply if you have equivalent years of education and/or experience equal to the education and experience requirements listed above.

  • The Government of Nunavut is committed to creating a representative workforce; therefore, priority will be given to Nunavut Inuit who self-identify as being enrolled under the Nunavut Agreement in accordance with the Priority Hiring Policy.
  • Government of Nunavut employees serving a probationary period must obtain and provide written authorization from the deputy head of their employing department. The authorization from the deputy head must accompany your application for your application to be considered.
  • Possession of a criminal record may not disqualify candidates from being considered. An assessment of the criminal record will be measured against the scope and duties of the position. This is only a requirement for positions that require a satisfactory criminal record or vulnerable sector check.
  • Applicants may submit their resume in any of the Official Languages of Nunavut.
  • Only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
  • The onus is on candidates in receipt of foreign post-secondary education credentials to have their foreign credentials assessed through a recognized Canadian education institution. Failure to do so may result in the rejection of their application.

title: Laundry Team Leader
description:
At InterContinental Malta, we are currently seeking a dependable and experienced Laundry Team Leader to oversee our laundry operations and lead the team in maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and presentation. The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating daily workloads, supervising team members, monitoring linen and uniform quality, and ensuring that all laundry operations run smoothly and efficiently.

This role requires strong organizational and leadership skills, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain high operational standards in a luxury hospitality environment.

Responsibilities

Your role will consist of:

  • Overseeing and coordinating daily laundry operations, including washing, drying, ironing, folding, and sorting of hotel linens, uniforms, and fabrics.

  • Leading, supervising, and supporting the laundry team to ensure tasks are completed efficiently and to the required standards.

  • Organizing daily workloads, allocating duties, and monitoring team performance to ensure smooth operations.

  • Ensuring the proper handling, care, and storage of hotel linens and uniforms to maintain quality and extend their lifespan.

  • Inspecting linen and uniforms for damage, stains, or wear, and coordinating with relevant departments for replacement or repairs.

  • Monitoring laundry stock and supplies, maintaining appropriate inventory levels, and requesting replenishment when required.

  • Ensuring that laundry equipment is used correctly, reporting maintenance issues, and coordinating necessary repairs.

  • Maintaining high standards of hygiene, cleanliness, health and safety, and compliance with hotel procedures.

  • Coordinating with Housekeeping and other relevant departments to ensure timely linen and uniform availability.

  • Handling special guest laundry requests and ensuring that these are completed promptly and professionally.

  • Training, guiding, and motivating team members while supporting the development of their skills and knowledge.

  • Identifying opportunities to improve workflows, reduce waste, and ensure the efficient use of equipment, supplies, and resources.

The duties and responsibilities described in this job description are not a comprehensive list, and as such additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time.

Skills and Experience

  • Previous experience in laundry or housekeeping operations, preferably within a hotel or a similar hospitality environment.

  • Previous supervisory or team leadership experience.

  • Good English communication skills, both verbal and written.

  • Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to lead, motivate, and support a team effectively.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and hygiene standards.

  • Ability to coordinate workloads and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

  • Basic knowledge of laundry equipment, linen care, and fabric handling procedures.

  • Ability to work flexible shifts, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.

Our Commitment to True Hospitality

At InterContinental Malta, we believe in True Hospitality, and this starts with a passionate team that is committed to exceeding expectations.

We genuinely care about people, and we show this through living out our promise of True Hospitality each and every day. It is what connects every colleague in all IHG® hotels.

  • True Attitude: Being caring, wanting to make a positive difference, and building genuine connections with guests.

  • True Confidence: Having the knowledge and skills to perform your role, and giving guests the confidence that they can trust you to help and support them during their stay.

  • True Listening: Focusing on what your guest is saying, picking up on body language that is often overlooked, and understanding what the guest wants and needs.

  • True Responsiveness: Providing guests with what they need in a timely and caring manner.

There is so much more to the job than we can capture here. It is simply about creating great experiences, doing the right thing, and understanding people.

description:

So, join us and you’ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

title: Senior Product Manager (all genders)
description:
About GeneralMind

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who can operate at the intersection of enterprise operations, AI systems, and platform product strategy.

You will work closely with customers, founders, and engineering teams to understand how large enterprises actually operate: ERP systems, supply chain workflows, approvals, exceptions, emails, spreadsheets, and fragmented operational processes.

This is not a traditional roadmap-management role. A core part of the job is identifying the reusable platform hidden underneath customer-specific operational problems. You will help determine what becomes a platform capability and what stays customer-specific, where configuration ends and engineering begins, where AI can reliably automate workflows, and where humans should remain in the loop.

Tasks

  • Work directly with enterprise customers to deeply understand operational workflows and pain points.
  • Translate customer realities into scalable product and platform decisions.
  • Define roadmap priorities across platform, workflow, and AI capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering teams on architecture and product tradeoffs.
  • Drive product thinking around AI agents, workflow orchestration, and enterprise operations.
  • Identify recurring patterns across customers and turn them into reusable product abstractions.
  • Help define the long-term platform strategy of the company.
  • Improve how we capture, operationalise, and learn from customer feedback.

Requirements

  • Strong product thinking and systems intuition.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise operations, supply chain workflows, or ERP systems.
  • Ability to operate effectively in highly technical environments.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to balance customer needs with long-term platform strategy.
  • A strong ownership mentality and execution focus.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Excitement about AI-native products and autonomous systems.

Child and Family Practitioner

Parenting Support Worker- North covering Lancaster, Morecambe, Fylde and Wyre

Join Us in Making a Difference

Are you passionate about helping children, young people and families thrive? Do you enjoy building positive relationships, supporting change, and working as part of a dedicated team? If so, we'd love to hear from you.

As a Child and Family Practitioner, you'll play a vital role in supporting children, young people and their families across Lancashire. Working alongside Social Workers, Senior Social Workers and other professionals, you'll provide practical and direct support that helps families overcome challenges and achieve positive, lasting outcomes.

This is a rewarding opportunity to be part of a supportive team that is committed to safeguarding children, promoting resilience and helping families reach their full potential.

About the Role

You'll work directly with children, young people, parents and carers, supporting identified pieces of work and delivering interventions that bring about meaningful change. You'll have the opportunity to make a real difference through relationship-based practice, while being supported through regular supervision, team discussions and ongoing professional development.

As part of the role, you'll maintain accurate case records, contribute to planning and reviews, and work collaboratively with partner agencies to ensure children and families receive the right support at the right time.

The role may occasionally require evening, weekend or public holiday working to meet the needs of the families we support.

Our Vision

We want all children, young people and their families to be:

  • Safe and protected from harm
  • Healthy and resilient
  • Heard and involved in decisions affecting them
  • Supported to achieve their full potential
  • Able to enjoy a happy and fulfilling life in Lancashire

What You'll Be Doing

Working Directly with Children and Families

  • Build positive relationships with children, young people, parents and carers.
  • Undertake direct work with families to support positive change and improve outcomes.
  • Work with children who are subject to Child in Need plans, Child Protection plans and those who are looked after.
  • Support families to develop strengths, resilience and independence.
  • Plan and facilitate group sessions for parents and carers.

Supporting Social Work Practice

  • Work alongside Social Workers on assessments and interventions.
  • Assist with Child and Family Assessments, exploitation assessments, risk assessments and safety planning.
  • Attend meetings and contribute to developing SMART plans that focus on achieving positive outcomes.
  • Participate in the team's duty rota and support service delivery as required.

Recording and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate, high-quality electronic records on LCS.
  • Produce reports and contribute information for meetings and reviews.
  • Ensure all work is recorded in an analytical and child-focused way.

Partnership Working

  • Develop strong working relationships with colleagues, partner agencies and community organisations.
  • Work collaboratively to ensure families receive coordinated and effective support.
  • Promote the voices of children, young people and families in decision-making.

Advocacy and Participation

  • Help children, young people and families understand their rights and access appropriate services.
  • Support individuals to express their views and wishes in meetings and reviews.
  • Challenge inequality, discrimination and barriers to accessing support.
  • Promote inclusive practice and celebrate diversity in everything you do.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about improving outcomes for children and families.
  • Has excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Can work confidently with families facing complex challenges.
  • Values partnership working and collaborative practice.
  • Is organised, motivated and able to maintain high-quality records.
  • Is committed to anti-discriminatory practice and child-centred approaches.
  • Can work flexibly to meet the needs of the service.

Why Join Us?

Working with us means joining a team that genuinely cares about the children, families and communities we serve. You'll benefit from:

  • A supportive and experienced team environment.
  • Regular supervision and professional guidance.
  • Opportunities for learning and development.
  • The chance to make a meaningful difference every day.
  • A role where your skills, ideas and commitment are valued.

If you're passionate about helping children and families create brighter futures, we'd love to welcome you to our team.

The post you are applying for is covered by the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (Exceptions) Order 1975 (as amended in 2013). If successful you will be required to apply to the Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) for a 'disclosure'. Further information can be found on the 'Our Recruitment Process' tab.

You will be required to provide a car for use in connection with the duties of this post and must be insured for business use. However, we may consider you if you cannot drive because of a disability.

Local Government Reorganisation

The Government has confirmed that local government across Lancashire will be reorganised, with the current 15 councils being replaced by four new unitary councils covering North, South, East and West Lancashire from April 2028.

If you are successful in your application, you will initially join Lancashire County Council. description:

Here, how we empower our people is extraordinary: Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and Cigna Healthy Workforce honors three years running — and what we build is world-class: recognized as CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024 — evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next”.

In a world where you can be anything, Be Infoblox.

Sales Engineer II - Kentik

Infoblox recently completed the acquisition of Kentik, an industry leader in network intelligence and observability. Together, we are combining Infoblox's authoritative DNS and asset context with Kentik's real-time visibility into network traffic, paths and performance to build an AI-driven networking and security platform for hybrid and multi-cloud environments. We have an opportunity for a Sales Engineer to join our sales team in Tokyo, reporting to the Senior Manager, Sales Engineering. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and partners across Japan and Korea, providing presales consultation, solution recommendations, and hands-on technical support to identify business challenges and develop effective technical solutions. You will collaborate closely with sales, channel partners, and cross-functional teams to drive revenue growth through high-touch presales engagements and end-to-end technical guidance throughout the sales cycle, from initial discovery and solution design through successful deal closure.

Be a Contributor - What You’ll do

  • Lead customer value discovery to uncover critical pains, desired outcomes, and decision criteria; translate these into measurable hypotheses, KPIs, and executive win-themes that guide the sales strategy
  • Diagnose the customer’s current state and design the desired future state architecture, mapping Infoblox capabilities to quantified business outcomes, risk reduction, and time-to-value
  • Build executive-ready ROI/TCO models and qualified business cases that articulate economic impact, cost of inaction, productivity gains, and operational risk mitigation
  • Plan and execute PoV engagements with clear success criteria tied to outcomes; baseline current performance, instruction telemetry, and validate value hypotheses with agreed metrics
  • Drive a mutual evaluation plan with the account team and champion, aligning to Meddicc/Meddpicc elements (Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria/Process, Paper Process, Identified Pain, Champion, Competition)
  • Present value narratives to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including C-level audiences, using clear storytelling that connects architecture choices to financial and operational results
  • Differentiate against competitors using value-based messaging – emphasize measurable outcomes, total economic impact, and unique risk coverage rather than feature parity
  • Collaborate on pricing and packaging anchored in delivered value; recommend right-sized scopes, phased value realization, and reference architectures that accelerate adoption
  • Maintain rigorous SFDC hygiene and cadence: document value hypotheses, PoV success criteria, metrics status, economic buyer access, and next best actions throughout the cycle
  • Capture validated outcomes and customer references; contribute quantified value stories, templates, ROI calculators, and playbook assets back to the field for reuse
  • Leverage AI-enabled presales workflows across discovery, solutioning, and execution: account research, call note summarization, action-item extraction, competitive analysis, RFP/RFI drafting, demo/storyline generation, and PoV telemetry analysis tied to value metrics
  • Build and maintain reusable AI prompt libraries, templates, and governed knowledge bases to ground outputs in approved content; continuously refine prompts for accuracy and tone
  • Leverage AI-assisted insights to sharpen customer discovery, tailor value messaging, and improve technical and storytelling

Be Prepared - What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering, or equivalent
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in sales engineering or customer-facing presales technical presales role, preferably within a direct sales environment
  • Strong hands-on expertise in network and application protocols, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity technologies
  • Demonstrated ability to run value selling motions end to end: discovery, diagnosis, quantification (ROI/TCO), PoV proof, executive business case, and value realization handoff
  • Proven experience designing and conducting PoV engagements with outcome-based success criteria and telemetry-driven valuation
  • Working proficiency with value-based selling frameworks (eg. MEDDICC/MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN) including access to the economic buyer and clear definition of metrics and decision criteria
  • Practical experience with AI tools in presales (eg. LLM copilots, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, summarization, translation, and data analysis) to accelerate discovery notes, RFP/RFI responses, demo storylines, competitive battlecards, and PoV telemetry analysis
  • Experience applying AI to accelerate account preparation, competitive positioning, proposal development, and opportunity follow-through
  • Strong discipline in using AI alongside Salesforce and established sales processes to support better execution, higher quality output, and improve productivity
  • Comfortable operating in a dynamic, start-up environment, with a proactive and hands-on approach to problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration

Be Successful - Your Path

First 90 Days: Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors, and map the systems and stakeholders that rely on your work. Stand up AI-assisted value discovery guides, an approved prompt library grounded in corporate content, and standard PoV success criteria and dashboards for your key segments.

Six Months: Work autonomously in sales engagement and technical discussion, conducting PoC/PoV independently, and use functional teams to provide additional support. Deliver multiple quantified business cases and PoVs that validate outcomes against baseline metrics; demonstrate measurable improvements in proposal/RFP turnaround and MEDDICC completeness via AI workflows.

One Year: Own your domain, mentor the next newcomer, create and recommend new product features and enhancements, speaking in webinars, marketing events and/or writing technical blogs, and meet or exceed your annual targets. Be recognized for advancing value selling excellence, codifying AI-enabled presales practices, and capturing customer outcome stories that raise win rates and shorten cycle times.

Belong— Your Community

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here. Click here to learn more about life as a Bloxer.

Be Rewarded — Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong

  • Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops.

  • Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations.
  • Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match.

Ready to Be the Difference?

title: Senior Project Associate (maternity cover)
description:
Introduction

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Internal and external candidates will be considered for this vacancy. For the purposes of this vacancy, internal candidates are defined as staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded or ungraded contract, including Junior Professional Officers (JPOs), staff on Special Leave Without Pay (SLWOP), UN Volunteers with at least twelve (12) months of continuous service in IOM, and staff members on secondment/loan released by the Organization, unless otherwise specified in their contract. Staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded contract will not retain their contract type if appointed to an ungraded position.

Organizational Context and Scope

The International Organization for Migration in the United Kingdom (IOM UK) delivers a range of programming to support migrants, both in the UK and internationally, including projects focusing on labour migration, migration and development, protection, and community cohesion, as well as provision of immigration advice.

This position will support IOM’s work under the direct supervision of the Programme Manager in the Migration and Development Team and the overall guidance of the Chief of Mission of IOM UK. Working in close coordination with relevant country and regional offices, units at our HQ in Geneva, and other teams at the IOM London, the incumbent will assist in the planning, implementation, monitoring and reporting of relevant migrant support projects managed by IOM London as well as support the development of new projects. The incumbent will also liaise with external stakeholders on matters related to communications, project development and reporting as well as may represent IOM in external forums and meetings.

Duties will include but not be limited to:

1. Provide specialized assistance in planning and implementation of activities under the relevant migrant support projects in line with donor guidance and mission’s strategies, policies and relevant fundraising approaches.

2. Support in monitoring and evaluation and provide input into the preparation of periodic and annual narrative reports in line with donor requirements.

3. Ensure project documents and information are appropriately filed and processed within IOM internal systems.

4. Liaise with the Communications Officer to make sure that relevant project information and learning are disseminated in a timely manner through a range of different channels.

5. Provide support in preparation of project proposals for Migration and Development as part of broader project development, in close coordination with supervisor and all relevant stakeholders.

6. Maintain liaison with relevant governmental, non-governmental entities as well as other international organisations and local NGOs on programme issues and participate in meetings as relevant.

7. Provide administrative support to the team.

8. Perform such other related duties as may be assigned.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • Completed University degree from an accredited institution in a field relevant to migration management, humanitarian and/or development assistance and at least 4 years professional experience or school diploma with 6 years of relevant professional experience.

  • Advanced degree or qualification relevant to the topics of migration and development, monitoring and evaluation, protection, safeguarding, integration and/or immigration advice would be an advantage.

Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database.

Experience

  • Relevant experience in migration related issues;

  • Experience and proven competencies in liaising with a variety of stakeholders, including governmental authorities, international and national institutions, diplomatic missions and non-governmental partners; prior experience working with FCDO would be an advantage;

  • Experience in project design, and project implementation and monitoring;

  • Ability to prepare clear and concise reports;

  • Experience in North Africa region is an advantage.

Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Excellent organizational and administrative skills, with strong attention to details

  • Ability to work to deadlines and under pressure

  • Ability to respond quickly and diligently to simultaneous requests

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a multi-cultural setting

Languages

All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish).

For this position, fluency in English is required.

Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.

Required Competencies

IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link. Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
  • Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
  • Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
  • Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
  • Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.

Core Competencies – behavioural indicators

  • Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
  • Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
  • Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
  • Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators (applicable only if with direct reports)

  • Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential.
  • Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential.
  • Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty.
  • Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction.
  • Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings.

Notes

Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category.

Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.

Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances.

IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities.

IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts.

IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application.

No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

Summary:

    Individua opportunità di miglioramento tecnologico o metodologico, migliorando le prestazioni del sistema e la struttura del software contribuendo alla definizione e all'evoluzione delle linee guida per lo sviluppo software di System Engineering, degli standard di workflow e degli strumenti innovativi all'interno della GBU

title: AI Video Creator (Intern) @ AI Startup (Full-time) Munich/Barcelona/Remote
description:
Somewhere in a factory, someone is about to reach into a running machine. Your video can prevent the accident.

Akdo makes safety trainings and videos for some of the world's largest industrial companies. No slide decks, no stock photos: short, sharp videos about what really happens on the factory floor. Our AI tool writes the script, generates the scenes and cuts the video. You tell it what to do, and you make sure the result is right.

Tasks

What you'll do

  • Turn real accidents into short videos.
    A forklift hits a worker in a blind corner. A hand gets caught in a conveyor belt during cleaning. The customer sends us the accident report. You figure out what happened and why, ask the customer when something is unclear, and turn the report into a 2-minute video.
  • Show how it's done right.
    How to switch off a machine safely before repairing it? How to change a blade without cutting yourself? How to set up a machine without skipping the step that matters? You turn dry procedures into clear, step-by-step videos a new hire can follow on day one.
  • Direct the AI.
    You create scenes with AI image and video tools and keep them realistic: the right machine, gloves and helmet where they belong, hands where they'd really be. The same worker looks the same in every shot. When the AI gets something wrong, you tell it exactly what to fix so the customer finds nothing to be corrected.
  • Shape the tool you work with.
    You'll use Akdo's video editor every day, more than anyone else on the team. When something is slow, clunky or missing, you tell our engineers directly, and often see it fixed within days. You test new features before customers do. Your feedback goes straight to the people who build it.
  • Work across the team.
    You build demo videos for our CEO Max before meetings with big companies, often on short notice. You work on customer projects with the team. And you use our video editor every day and tell our engineers what's slow or missing.

Requirements

You are a fit if

  • You've edited videos before, in any tool: Premiere, Davinci, Capcut or whatever
  • You've gotten consistent, detailed results out of AI image or video tools, and can show us.
  • You notice details and spot what’s off: a missing glove, a machine that doesn't move that way
  • You like fast turnarounds and changing priorities, or you ask questions until they make sense
  • You understand things quickly and think for yourself. You don't just accept what the AI gives you.
  • Your English is excellent. German is a plus.
  • You're available full-time for 6 months.

A background in communications, media, journalism, psychology, design, film, or anything where craft matters is a plus — but we care more about curiosity than credentials.

❗ Even if you don't check every box, what matters most is your excitement about the role 🤗

Why Akdo

  • Your videos go live. Workers at some of the world's biggest companies will watch what you make.
  • You learn from the best: Alice and Lena (CLO and experienced editor), plus a founding team from decacorns and YC (look up Max, Jonas on LinkedIn).
  • Paid internship, Munich, Barcelona or Remote, with regular team get-togethers. Before applying, please consider whether you love working from home in Germany for a large part of your time
  • What comes next: strong interns get a full-time offer in Munich or Barcelona

How we hire

  1. Apply with a link to 1–3 videos you've edited, any tool and any topic. We can't consider applications without a video + Please note that we only accept applications in English. This applies to your CV, cover letter and all other documents.
  2. Intro call with Lorenzo (20 min)
  3. Challenge (45 min, remote): turn a short accident report into a storyboard plus key visuals
  4. Deep dive with Lena and Max
  5. Offer 🚀
