title: Sterile Processing Tech 1
description:
Inova Loudoun Hospital is looking for a dedicated Sterile Processing Tech 1 to join the Team. This full-time role will be evening-shift working 3:00pm – 11:30pm Monday – Friday with every other weekend located in Leesburg, VA.


The Sterile Processing Tech 1 assembles instrumentation accurately and efficiently. Ensures sterility of all processed items. Decontaminates instruments in a safe and appropriate manner. Manages instrument inventory and ensures timely distribution of instruments to all customers. Understands basic computer functions to assist in documentation and tracking of inventory.

Inova is consistently ranked a national healthcare leader in safety, quality and patient experience. We are also proud to be consistently recognized as a top employer in both the D.C. metro area and the nation.

Featured Benefits:

  • Committed to Team Member Health: offering medical, dental and vision coverage, and a robust team member wellness program.
  • Retirement: Inova matches the first 5% of eligible contributions – starting on your first day.
  • Tuition and Student Loan Assistance: offering up to $5,250 per year in education assistance and up to $10,000 for student loans.
  • Mental Health Support: offering all Inova team members, their spouses/partners, and their children 25 mental health coaching or therapy sessions, per person, per year, at no cost.
  • Work/Life Balance: offering paid time off, paid parental leave, flexible work schedules.

Sterile Processing Tech 1 Responsibilities:

  • Inspects instruments and ensures that they are free from bio-burden and in proper working condition prior to assembling sets according to count sheets. Locates missing instrumentation and replaces repaired/ordered instrumentation in sets. Maintains stock levels in the assembly area. Loads items to be sterilized on the loading cart and records them on the load card, adding a biological test to each load. Utilizes instrument tracking computer software to document all functions in the instrument assembly area.
  • Selects the proper mode of sterilization for all items.
  • Ensures the presence of all required chemical and biological indicators.
  • Operates all sterilization equipment (Steam, Sterrad, Steris). Validates sterilization process by reading, interpreting, and documenting all chemical and biological indicators. Utilizes instrument tracking computer software to document all functions related to sterilization. Decontaminates instruments in a safe and appropriate manner.
  • Unloads case carts, checking all items for red tags. Properly sorts instrumentation and selects the proper processing mechanisms (manual and mechanical) to ensure the integrity of and prevent damage to the items.
  • Prepares instrumentation for the decontamination process, including flushing lumens, exposing all surfaces and properly loading washers. Operates washer/decontaminates, cart washers, sonic washer, and all other equipment in the decontamination area. Utilizes instrument tracking computer software to document all functions in the decontamination area. Decontaminates instruments in a safe and appropriate manner.
  • Manages instrument inventory and assures timely distribution of instruments to all customers. Maintains par levels of all individual items, instrument sets, procedure trays, and MSET boxes.
  • Properly stores or distributes items assuring that each item has been properly labeled and sterilized.
  • Utilizes instrument tracking computer software to document all functions related to storage and distribution.
  • May perform additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: High School or GED

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous sterile processing experience preferred.

  • Medical/hospital experience preferred.

title: Value Delivery Intern - Automations
description:
About GeneralMind

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

About the role

In the Value Delivery team, we take our enterprise customers from first pilot to full production rollout: scoping ERP integrations, running clean handovers between teams, making sure nothing falls through the cracks. A lot of that still runs on manual work today, and that's exactly where you come in.

You'll automate how we work internally. Linear workflows, delivery reporting, and small internal tools that give the team back hours every week. You won't be working on our core product. You'll be building the tools that make the team behind it faster and smarter, and you'll use AI daily to build them.

What you will do

Your first months at GeneralMind will involve hands-on work with our value delivery and automation processes, helping deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains.

  • Process orders, validate invoices, and coordinate suppliers directly on top of enterprise systems.
  • Handle operational exceptions and track handovers to meet strict deadlines and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with the team to ensure autonomous workflows execute smoothly and accurately.

What we are looking for

We are seeking someone ready to dive into enterprise AI automation during a 4-month internship based on-site in Berlin. You will work 40 hours per week under a 2-month probation period. If you match most of these requirements rather than every single one, we encourage you to send us your application.

Benefits

We provide a company laptop for your daily work, alongside free snacks and free beverages in the office, plus 25 paid vacation days per year.

Your first months at GeneralMind

During your initial weeks, you will take on core automation workflows, learning how our operational AI layer manages enterprise tasks. By the end of your internship, you will have shipped end-to-end process executions and gained direct experience in enterprise AI deployment.

title: HSQE Advisor | South Australia
description:
This site-based 8 days on 6 days off role is suited to practical, people-focused HSQE professional who enjoys working closely with operational leaders and frontline teams to manage risk, strengthen compliance, support food safety and hygiene standards, and contribute to positive safety culture.

As an HSQE Advisor, you will support village-based hospitality operations, working across accommodation, catering, cleaning and support services. You will provide practical HSQE advice, conduct risk assessments, inspections and audits, support incident investigation and hazard management, and help operational teams understand and apply Civeo’s systems and standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the implementation of Civeo’s HSQE Integrated Management System at site level.

  • Conduct inspections, audits and risk assessments across village operations.

  • Monitor hazards, incidents, corrective actions and compliance trends.

  • Coach and support managers, supervisors and frontline teams in safe work practices.

  • Support food safety hygiene, housekeeping and quality assurance activities.

  • Assist with toolbox talks, inductions, training and communication of key learnings.

  • Support emergency preparedness, incident investigations, and continuous improvement initiatives.

ABOUT YOU:

We are looking for someone who can combine technical HSQE knowledge with strong communication, practical problem-solving and the ability to build trust with operational teams.

Essential:

  • Certificate IV (or equivalent) in Work Health and Safety, or related area.

  • Current Australian driver’s license.

  • Experience in a safety, quality, risk, compliance or related operational role.

  • Sounds understanding of risk management, hazard identification, incident investigation, and corrective action management.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work safely and effectively in a remote FIFO village environment.

  • Meet the requirements of a pre-employment medical.

Highly regarded:

  • Diploma in Work Health and Safety
  • Lead Auditor, ICAM investigation, Food Safety, Training & Assessment or Risk Management qualifications.
  • Experience in hospitality, accommodation, catering, mining, resources or remote operations.
  • Familiarity with IMS, ISO 9001, ISO 45001, ISO 14001, HACCP or food safety assurance.

Attributes we value:

  • Practical, calm and solution-focused
  • Builds and maintains positive working relationships with leaders and frontline teams.
  • Confident to coach, influence and have respectful safety conversations.
  • Organized, detail-oriented and reliable with reporting and follow-up.
  • Committed to Civeo’s values of Safety, Respect, Care, Excellence, Integrity and Collaboration.

THE PERKS:

  • Competitive salary aligned to skills, qualifications, and experience.

  • Quality on-site catering with a selection of nutritious food to satisfy all dietary requirements.

  • Single, ensuited private rooms

  • Recreational facilities which include gym, sporting fields, pool and various other amenities.

  • Wellbeing support, including access to Employee Assistance Program for you and your immediate family.

  • Retail discounts via access to the Civvy Hive.

  • Growth opportunities to progress your career and professional development.
